title: Write integration test: 3-WU parallel batch against a temp git repo
description: Create tests/test_batch_integration.py with a pytest-asyncio async test. Use tmp_path to create a bare git repo, initialise it with an initial commit, and create a SessionManager pointed at it. Build a minimal state.json with 3 ready WUs. Stub execute_wu() (or patch run_query_json) so each task writes its verdict to a shared results store and performs a real worktree create/remove cycle against the temp repo. Assert: (1) all 3 WU branches were created and merged or cleaned up, (2) state.json after the batch contains all 3 WU IDs with no entry clobbering a sibling's status, (3) run_batch() returns summary with passed=3.
acceptance_criteria: A pytest fixture creates a temporary git repository with at least one commit on main
The test calls run_batch() (not execute_wu() directly) against the fixture repo
After run_batch() returns, state.json on disk reflects the correct final status for all 3 WUs with no clobbered entries
The summary dict returned by run_batch() shows passed=3, failed=0, reshaped=0
The test is marked async and runs under pytest-asyncio with asyncio_mode='auto'

implementer_report.summary: Created tests/test_batch_integration.py with an async pytest-asyncio integration test. A git_repo fixture initialises a real git repo on main with an initial commit. A session_manager fixture builds state.json with 3 independent pending WUs (WU-101/102/103, non-overlapping solution_domains). run_query_json is patched at overture.batch_manager.run_query_json with an async stub that identifies the WU ID and agent role from the prompt text and returns schema-valid fake implementer/reviewer responses, so real worktree create/remove cycles run against the fixture repo while no network calls are made. Three assertions cover all ACs: (1) summary shows passed=3, failed=0, reshaped=0; (2) state.json post-batch has all 3 WU keys with status=completed and no clobbered id fields; (3) all three wu/* branches have been deleted by remove_worktree(). pyproject.toml was updated with pytest and pytest-asyncio>=0.24 as optional test dependencies and asyncio_mode='auto' under [tool.pytest.ini_options].

domain_breaches.justification: pytest-asyncio must be declared as a test dependency and asyncio_mode='auto' must be configured in [tool.pytest.ini_options] for async tests to be collected and run without per-test @pytest.mark.asyncio decorators. Without these two additions the test cannot execute at all, making the change strictly unavoidable despite pyproject.toml being outside solution_domain.

implementer_report.commit_message: test(WU-005): add 3-WU parallel batch integration test against temp git repo
